whatsappMessage:
Hi Bakery Junction Team,

I noticed your bakery has stellar 4.8★ reviews near Don Bosco Academy in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for birthday cakes and custom orders.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, menu showcase, aur special occasion hampers integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bakeryjunction

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Bakery Junction Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Bakery Junction-Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and a showcase of your top-rated treats near Don Bosco Academy. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
